Implemented the persistent HTTP key-value service in [server.py](/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/codex-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T114822Z/skill-state-v3/http-kv/server.py) with documentation in [README.md](/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/codex-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T114822Z/skill-state-v3/http-kv/README.md).
